heading: Faster connections and file navigation
summary: Expand OpenSSH aliases to direct addresses, revisit SFTP paths with mouse buttons, and move remote file panels within a tab.
changes: Use an alias as a direct address
Choose Use address to expand the effective hostname, user, port, and identity from OpenSSH configuration into the connection form.
Use the mouse Back and Forward buttons over a file panel. Right-click a file or folder to copy its full path.
Drag a remote panel by its grip to move it within the current SFTP tab. Click unused list space to clear the selection.
Returning to a tab refreshes its visible terminal dimensions and display.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
